links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT AAA patient information versus Healthdirect Australia resource
links.effect: ChatGPT readability was at a college level, while HDA was at a 10th to 12th-grade level; ChatGPT responses were longer than HDA.
links.quote: Readability was at a college level for ChatGPT, while HDA was at a 10th to 12th-grade level.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT responses to patient education questions on abdominal aortic aneurysms evaluated by an expert for readability, understandability, and actionability, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
